fusions.name: Towering Fuss
fusions.desc: Rears up and strikes every enemy within 3 tiles for 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Heavy-Handed Cuff
fusions.desc: Cuffs the target with a clawed wing for 12 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every tenth of your health already gone, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Den Mother's Challenge
fusions.desc: Draws up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds, and you take 20% less damage for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
